text: Agrovision, the company behind The Fruitist berry brand, is a founder-led, investor-backed private company; co-founder Steve Magami is its CEO.
short: Agrovision (Fruitist) is founder-led; Steve Magami is CEO and co-founder.

source.name: PR Newswire – Agrovision Corp. release: 'Superfruit Industry Disruptor Agrovision Announces Largest Equity Financing to Date'
source.quote: The company is founder-led and backed by leading investors that are aligned with Agrovision's values and long-term mission and vision.

additionalSources.name: The Packer – 'A look at Agrovision's transition to Fruitist'
additionalSources.quote: The company also is expanding its product line to include other premium superfruits such as blackberries, raspberries and cherries, said Steve Magami, CEO and co-founder.
